ns2:course.label: Economics of Education
ns2:course.description: Introduction to economic concepts and their application to education, including investment and consumption theories of education and the role of human capital in economic growth and development; cost-benefit analyses in education, education and the distribution of income, and manpower and educational planning. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
